Thanks — invite sent for Mon 9/7 10:00–10:30 PT (Zoom link in calendar). Agenda attached to the event.

To help us focus, I pulled three items I expect will come up and added brief notes below so you can pre-check with your team: 
1) Residency: hosted (Redwood API) logs are stored in the region for the serving cluster by default; for Hosted customers we can implement a region-only retention policy for token-level logs on request. For Dedicated/Private we can guarantee residency.
2) KMS/BYOK: supported on Dedicated and Private deployments today; Hosted offers envelope encryption and integration with customer KMS is in beta via KMIP.
3) Audit exports: we can produce JSON (line-delimited) or CSV exports; our recommended export for SIEM ingestion is NDJSON with a small schema we attached. Exports can be scheduled daily or weekly; retention configurable up to 3 years depending on plan.

On the call we'll ask for a point of contact for each evidence item (e.g., policy docs, logging samples, network diagrams). If you can upload your filled questionnaire to the Drive link ahead of the meeting that would speed things up.

See you shortly.

-Stephanie
